description: Prompts and expected behaviors for manual/agent skill evaluations; these are evaluation specifications, not executed tests.

scenarios.prompt: I have a React Router commerce site. Make the product grid to detail feel premium with a card-to-hero morph without breaking Back and deep links.
disallowed: Use a random slide/fade for every page

scenarios.prompt: Create an immersive new agency portfolio with highly original page transitions.
disallowed: Claim a subjective design score is a measured metric

scenarios.prompt: My existing Next.js App Router dashboard needs seamless page changes with low engineering risk.
expected: Prefer low-cost native or local transitions
disallowed: Require full live parallel route mounts

scenarios.prompt: Build a museum with a persistent artifact that rotates between room pages, and a fallback for older phones.
expected: Persistent canvas and single camera owner

scenarios.prompt: Fix a failing unit test in the currency formatter; do not touch the UI.
expected: Do not activate KX motion workflow

scenarios.prompt: Make our current animations safe and usable for prefers-reduced-motion users and verify keyboard focus.
